definitions.explanation: A formal term referring to a married couple, often used when speaking about others respectfully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：noentry⟧{夫妻|ふさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I invited Mr. and Mrs. Tanaka to the party.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{夫妻|ふさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}さそう→良い：02350_yoi⟧だ。
examples.english: That married couple seems to get along well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：noentry⟧{夫妻|ふさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧30⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: Mr. and Mrs. Yamada will celebrate their 30th wedding anniversary next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鈴木|すずき}→鈴木：noentry⟧{夫妻|ふさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Mr. and Mrs. Suzuki live overseas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧{夫妻|ふさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company president and his wife attended the ceremony.

notes:
{夫妻|ふさい} is a formal way to refer to a married couple, typically used when speaking about others (not oneself).

Usage:
- [surname]{夫妻|ふさい} - Mr. and Mrs. [surname]
- Often used in formal contexts, news, or when showing respect

Related terms:
- {夫婦|ふうふ} (husband and wife - more common, can refer to one's own marriage)
- ご{夫婦|ふうふ} (married couple - polite)
- カップル (couple - loanword, not necessarily married)

Difference:
- {夫妻|ふさい} - used for others, more formal
- {夫婦|ふうふ} - more general, can be used for self or others
